new_source: QEVD explicit squat issue labels only
limitations: Known squat clips only; no exercise recognition stage tested.
This particular frozen51clip worker holdout has now been evaluated and cannot become a fresh test in later experiments.
Clip-level Wilson interval assumes independent clips; worker bootstrap interval better reflects clustering, but few workers limit precision.
GOOD means QEVD no obvious issue; BAD limited to explicit back/depth/insufficient annotations, not every possible squat issue.
